# Deterministic text fixture

`Cantarell-Regular.ttf` is the redistributable Cantarell Regular font used by deterministic RunenUI text shaping and renderer-realization tests. It is bundled so conformance evidence does not depend on host-installed font selection.

The font is covered by the SIL Open Font License 1.1. The retained license notice is `Cantarell-Regular.OFL.txt` beside the font binary.
